observations: Photo 0: Closed laptop lid with a pattern of small cutouts and a watermark 'GLORY LOVE'. No visible brand or model on lid.
Photo 1: Open laptop showing screen with 'Bubu & Co' text, ASUS logo below screen, rose gold chassis, black keyboard. Stickers on palm rest: Intel, ASUS Laptop, and others. Power cable connected.
Photo 2: Similar view to photo 1, screen shows 'Bubu & Co' in white text, ASUS logo visible, same stickers on palm rest. Cables and power strip visible under desk.
The laptop appears to be powered on in both photos 1 and 2, as the screen is lit and Windows taskbar is visible.
No visible damage to screen or keyboard in photos, but no close-up of screen for dead pixels or cracks.
Battery status is not visible in any photo; seller states 'Battery is bad'.

claims.evidence: Seller's text and ASUS logo visible in photo 1 and photo 2. Model name 'E410M' is stated by seller and consistent with ASUS branding.
No photo shows RAM or system specs. Cannot verify from photos alone.
No photo shows storage or system specs. Cannot verify from photos alone.
Intel sticker visible on palm rest in photo 1 and photo 2. While not specifying 'Celeron', Intel branding is present and consistent with seller's claim.
Seller states battery is bad, but no photo shows battery or charging status. Laptop is plugged in, so battery condition cannot be confirmed.

risks.risk: Battery is not functional or has very low capacity
risks.proof: Photo of battery indicator on screen or a video showing laptop running on battery for 5 minutes.

risks.risk: RAM is less than 4GB or not functioning properly
risks.proof: Screenshot of system properties showing installed RAM or a video of system running memory diagnostic tool.

risks.risk: SSD is less than 128GB or not functioning properly
risks.proof: Screenshot of disk management or file explorer showing drive size and health.

risks.risk: Screen has dead pixels, cracks, or backlight issues
risks.proof: Close-up photo of screen with solid white and black backgrounds.
risks.if_unproven: priced as screen with minor defects

risks.risk: Keyboard or touchpad has dead keys or unresponsive areas
risks.proof: Video of typing all keys and using touchpad.
risks.if_unproven: priced as keyboard with minor issues

proof_requests: Screenshot of system properties showing RAM and storage details.
Video of laptop running on battery for 5 minutes.
Close-up photo of screen with solid white and black backgrounds.
Video of typing all keys and using touchpad.
response.reason: The model and brand are supported, but key specifications (RAM, SSD, battery) cannot be verified from photos. Hidden risks related to battery, storage, RAM, screen, and keyboard must be proven before pricing. Without proof, the item cannot be priced accurately.
